UNION
SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = AP.DEPT_CODE) AS KEP_DEPT_NAME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR LUSR WHERE LUSR.USER_ID = AP.ADD_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = AP.AGENT_CODE) AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = AP.BUYER_CODE) AS BUYER_NAME, NULL AS CHANGE_DATE FROM KEPTAPDT AP WHERE 1=1 AND AP_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_from_date} AND STATUS <> 'D' AND CONFIRM_FLAG = 'N'
) X GROUP BY X.KEP_DEPT_NAME, X.KEP_USER_NAME, X.AGENT_NAME, X.BUYER_NAME, X.CHANGE_DATE ORDER BY X.KEP_DEPT_NAME, X.KEP_USER_NAME
